tip.title: Read between the lines
tip.text: Writers do not tell you everything. An INFERENCE is a smart guess that uses clues from the text plus what you already know. Formula: text clue + what I know = inference. If a character's hands shake and her voice is small, you can infer she is nervous, even if the word "nervous" is never written.

passage.title: The Empty Lunch Box
passage.text:
Every day at recess, Dindo opened his lunch box and ate quickly. But this week, he kept his lunch box closed. He said he was not hungry. Then he went to the water fountain and drank for a long time.

His classmate Bea noticed. She also noticed that Dindo's shoes had a hole near the toe and that he had worn the same shirt three days in a row. On Thursday, when Dindo was at the fountain, Bea looked at his lunch box. It was empty.

On Friday, Bea brought two sandwiches. "My mother made too many," she said, even though her mother had made exactly two. "Can you help me finish?" Dindo looked at the sandwich for a moment. Then he smiled a little and took it. They ate together by the window, not saying much. The next week, Bea's mother started making too many sandwiches every day.

words.meaning: saw or became aware of something
words.example: I noticed a crack in the wall.

words.meaning: precisely; not more and not less

items.prompt: Why did Dindo keep his lunch box closed this week?
choices: He did not like the food.
He had no food to bring.
items.why: Clues: the box was empty, he drank water for a long time, his shoes had a hole. Together they show he had no food.

items.prompt: Why did Bea say her mother made too many sandwiches?
choices: Her mother really made too many.
She wanted to share without embarrassing Dindo.
She wanted Dindo to pay her.
items.why: The text says her mother made "exactly two." Bea said "too many" so Dindo could accept without feeling ashamed.

items.prompt: What can you infer from the last sentence?
choices: Bea's family decided to keep helping Dindo.
items.why: "Started making too many sandwiches every day" means Bea's mother agreed to send food for Dindo from then on.

items.prompt: Which clue BEST shows that Dindo's family may be poor?
choices: He went to the water fountain.
His shoes had a hole and he wore the same shirt three days in a row.
items.why: Worn-out shoes and the same shirt for days are clues about his family's situation.

items.prompt: On what day did Bea look inside Dindo's lunch box?
items.why: "On Thursday, when Dindo was at the fountain, Bea looked at his lunch box."

items.prompt: "His classmate Bea noticed." What does noticed mean?
items.why: The next sentences list the things Bea saw, so noticed means she saw and paid attention.
